title: AI-Driven Lean Proof Search Autonomously Solves 9 Erdős & 44 OEIS Open Conjectures
aiSystem: Google DeepMind Formal Proof Search Agent (Lean 4)
whyItMatters: First large-scale evaluation of autonomous Lean 4 proof search on open research conjectures: 9/353 open Erdős problems and 44/492 OEIS conjectures proved for a few hundred dollars each.
summary: Google DeepMind evaluated an AlphaEvolve-inspired Lean formal proof search agent across hundreds of open mathematical conjectures. The system autonomously proved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems, 44 of 492 formalized OEIS conjectures, a 1996 Graffiti graph theory conjecture, and a bipartite graph reconstruction variant—at roughly a few hundred dollars of compute per solved theorem—followed by Epoch AI resolving 147 of the same 492 OEIS conjectures.
technicalHighlights: Autonomously proved 9/353 open Erdős problems and 44/492 formalized OEIS conjectures with full Lean 4 kernel verification.
Closed the AI-conjecture-to-proof loop by proving a 30-year-old open graph conjecture originally proposed by the Graffiti system in 1996.
Demonstrated unit economics of a few hundred dollars per formally verified open-problem resolution.
caveats: Many resolved OEIS and Erdős items are lower-tier open problems; success rates on flagship conjectures remained small in May 2026.

scoreRationale.foundational: Established scalable autonomous resolution across dozens of formally verified open conjectures.
scoreRationale.ripple: Proved that cheap, automated Lean proof search can systematically sweep entire conjecture repositories.
scoreRationale.verification: Every resolved theorem carries an independently checkable Lean 4 certificate.
scoreRationale.velocity: Dropped the cost of formally verifying new open theorems to a few hundred dollars of compute.
